verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Namecheap runs a separate sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) that answers API calls the same way production does, so a test environment exists. Nothing documents how developers obtain API credentials self-serve, or states that sandbox registrations are free; the Go SDK marks domain create and renew as charge-bearing, apparently against production. Missing for 10: documented self-serve API credential issuance, explicit documentation that sandbox registrations cost no real money, sandbox setup docs, and hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get API credentials self-serve and test safely — a sandbox or test environment where registrations don't cost real money
